description: This source file contains a benchmarking class 'ClassDeserializeBenchmark' that compares the deserialization performance of various serialization libraries (like Orleans, Json.NET, MessagePack, Protobuf, Hyperion, SpanJson, Utf8Json, System.Text.Json, and Newtonsoft.Json) for a specific class type 'IntClass'. It sets up serialized inputs and deserializers for multiple serialization formats, and defines benchmark methods to measure performance of each deserialization approach.
